compliance.definition: Requests whose promised date (PRJCOMPLETEDATE, set by the city on each request) fell in the week; share closed on or before that date. Cancelled requests excluded; services with at least 20 requests due in each week.

pothole_weekly.definition: Residential pothole requests by week filed: share of those closed that closed within 8 days (CityStat's goal; N4's definition C). Open requests are not counted, as CityStat does not count them.

first_step.definition: Resident-filed requests since 16 May 2025, one row per request number, closed with the same words: towing 'vehicle tagged for tow' (the inspector's first visit) and cave-ins 'referred to street maintenance for repair work to be scheduled' (the referral). Median days from filing to that closing, by ward as published in the file's WARD column (requests with a blank ward are left out, as in N3).

lists.title: City-owned lots closed "on schedule" with no cut billed since
lists.scope: Resident weed requests on land-bank (LRA) lots filed in 2026, closed within three days as "on schedule to be cut" or "added to rotation", with no grass cut billed on the parcel in the Forestry ledger after the request (ledger posted to the run date). Requests filed after mid-September have had little time.

lists.title: Cave-ins referred to Street Maintenance in the last 90 days: no completion record
lists.scope: Cave-in requests closed "referred to street maintenance for repair work to be scheduled" in the 90 days to the run date. No public file records when a referred cave-in is repaired, so every row is open as far as the record goes.

lists.title: Tree requests cancelled with no words at an address where a removal order was already open
lists.scope: 'Inspect City Tree' requests filed since 1 January 2025, cancelled with no public words, at the same address as a Forestry tree-removal work order that had started more than a day before (the city's published Cityworks sample: 1,500 of 2,522 open removal orders, so this undercounts).
